title: Deadline Duel
tagline: A game-like competition for hackathons rewarding teams who submit their projects at the last possible moment
description:
A game-like competition for hackathons rewarding teams who submit their projects at the last possible moment.
It will notarize the moment when the team will submit the project, and then be able to verify this proof to issue a memorable NFT (or POAP) to a hacker. A leaderboard also can be maintained of those who submitted their project the latest.
how_its_made: This project uses TLSNotary for the generating the proof of project submission. For this a plugin is created for the TLSNotary browser extension. Then the proof is verified by the DApp that will maintain the leaderboard and issue the memorable NFT to the user who will submit their project the latest.
